2026/02/11:

Turbo lora

It is recommended to use “Turbo LoRA,” which can generate images in just 4 steps. When CFG is set to 1, negative prompts will not take effect, but image generation will be faster. When CFG is set to 2, negative prompts will take effect, but image generation will be slower.

If Turbo LoRA is not used, please refer to the original “flux2 klein 9b base” for parameter settings.
